feature: Basic lands in the draft diff
note: Three surfaces, one deck. The defect was an ABSENCE — a draft that cut five Swamps and added five other lands drew no row on the review page and named no card in the banner — so the artefact that shows the fix is a photograph of the rows now being there, at both widths, on every surface that draws a diff. The version rail is the third row for the same reason it is named in the plan: `loadVersionDiff` never filtered basics, so it has been drawing `Swamp 5 → 0` correctly the whole time, and the sheet is what shows the draft's own page finally agreeing with it. `BASICS_DRAFT_DECK` comes from the environment, so no account's deck id lives here; point it at a committed deck whose draft has moved a basic land, which `pnpm probe:review` builds and tears down and `scripts/probe-review-changes.mjs` documents. The rail row is reached by pressing the deck's own `Versions` tab and then the version's row, rather than by a URL: the rail draws inside the deck page's tab panel, and a row's diff is fetched when the row opens. `button[aria-expanded]` alone would not do — the decklist's type groups carry it too — so the row is taken by its accessible name, which leads with `v2` — v1 is the initial list and draws no diff, having nothing before it to compare against. The row is scrolled to after opening: the rail sits below the deck's own head and its mix strip, so an unscrolled shot photographs the panel's heading and none of its rows. No `shares` block: the review row and the rail row are deliberately different components, because one carries availability and a control and the other is a historical record with neither.
